def fetch(url, path, headers=None, timeout=300):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers or {"User-Agent": UA["User-Agent"]})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r, open(path + ".part", "wb") as f:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b: break
            f.write(b)
    os.replace(path + ".part", path)

def bk_file(key):
    aid, durl = BK[key]
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "bk_" + aid + ".blend")
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000: return p
    errs = []
    for host_url in [durl, durl.replace("www.blenderkit.com", "api.blenderkit.com")]:
        try:
            h = dict(UA); h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
            q = host_url + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"scene_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4())})
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(q, headers=h), timeout=60)
            fp = json.loads(r.read().decode())["filePath"]
            fetch(fp, p)
            return p
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append(type(e).__name__ + ":" + str(getattr(e, "code", ""))[:6])
    NOTES.append("BK " + key + " " + "/".join(errs))
    return None

PH = "https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/"
def ph_tex(name, kind, res="1k"):
    ext = "jpg"
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "ph_%s_%s_%s.jpg" % (name, kind, res))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        try: fetch(PH + "Textures/jpg/%s/%s/%s_%s_%s.jpg" % (res, name, name, kind, res), p)
        except Exception as e:
            NOTES.append("PH " + name + kind); return None
    return p

def ph_hdri(name, res="2k"):
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "ph_%s_%s.hdr" % (name, res))
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        try: fetch(PH + "HDRIs/hdr/%s/%s_%s.hdr" % (res, name, res), p)
        except Exception: NOTES.append("PH hdri " + name); return None
    return p

def load_objs(key, coll_name=None):
    """append all renderable objects of a Blendkit file into a new scene collection; returns (collection, objects, top-level objects)"""
    p = bk_file(key)
    if not p: return None
    with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
        dt.objects = list(df.objects)
    coll = bpy.data.collections.new(coll_name or ("BK_" + key))
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)
    objs = []
    for o in dt.objects:
        if o is None: continue
        if o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT"): continue
        if o.hide_render and o.type != "ARMATURE": continue
        coll.objects.link(o); objs.append(o)
    names = set(o.name for o in objs)
    tops = [o for o in objs if o.parent is None or o.parent.name not in names]
    return coll, objs, tops

def bbox(objs):
    mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9)); mx = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for o in objs:
        if o.type != "MESH": continue
        for c in o.bound_box:
            w = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
            mn = Vector((min(mn.x, w.x), min(mn.y, w.y), min(mn.z, w.z)))
            mx = Vector((max(mx.x, w.x), max(mx.y, w.y), max(mx.z, w.z)))
    return mn, mx

EOF_CDL

# Generic rig posing for arbitrary humanoid armatures (Mixamo / Rigify DEF / custom).
# Poses are given in CHARACTER space (character faces -Y, +X = character's left, +Z up).
import re, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, Quaternion, Euler

SIDE_L = re.compile(r"(^|[^a-z])(left|l)([^a-z]|$)|\.l(\.|$)|_l(_|$|\.)|^l_|left", re.I)
SIDE_R = re.compile(r"(^|[^a-z])(right|r)([^a-z]|$)|\.r(\.|$)|_r(_|$|\.)|^r_|right", re.I)

def clean(n):
    n = n.lower()
    for p in ["mixamorig:", "mixamorig_", "def-", "def_", "cc_base_", "bip01_", "bip01 ", "b_", "jnt_"]:
        if n.startswith(p): n = n[len(p):]
    return n

def side(n):
    c = n.lower()
    if "left" in c: return "L"
    if "right" in c: return "R"
    if re.search(r"(\.|_|-)l(\.\d+)?$", c) or re.search(r"^l(_|\.)", c) or re.search(r"(_|\.)l(_|\.)", c): return "L"
    if re.search(r"(\.|_|-)r(\.\d+)?$", c) or re.search(r"^r(_|\.)", c) or re.search(r"(_|\.)r(_|\.)", c): return "R"
    return ""

def role(n):
    c = clean(n)
    if any(k in c for k in ["finger", "thumb", "index", "middle", "ring", "pinky", "toe", "eye", "jaw", "teeth", "tongue", "twist", "breast", "hair", "brow", "lid", "lip", "cheek", "nose", "ear", "roll", "pole", "ik", "tweak", "mch", "org", "socket", "prop", "weapon", "end"]):
        return None
    s = side(n)
    if re.search(r"fore_?arm|lower_?arm|lowerarm|elbow", c): r = "fa"
    elif re.search(r"upper_?arm|^arm|leftarm|rightarm|(^|[^a-z])arm([^a-z]|$)", c) and "fore" not in c: r = "ua"
    elif re.search(r"shoulder|clavicle|collar", c): r = "sh"
    elif re.search(r"hand|wrist", c): r = "hd"
    elif re.search(r"thigh|up_?leg|upper_?leg|upleg", c): r = "th"
    elif re.search(r"shin|calf|lower_?leg|knee|(^|[^a-z])leg([^a-z]|$)|leftleg|rightleg", c): r = "sn"
    elif re.search(r"foot|ankle", c): r = "ft"
    elif re.search(r"neck", c): return "neck"
    elif re.search(r"head", c): return "head"
    elif re.search(r"spine|chest|torso|abdomen|^back", c): return "spine"
    elif re.search(r"hips|pelvis", c) and not s: return "hips"
    else: return None
    return r + s if s else None

class Rig:
    def __init__(self, arm, base_rot=None):
        """arm: armature object. base_rot: 3x3 rotation from armature space to character space (default from current matrix_world)."""
        self.arm = arm
        mw = arm.matrix_world.to_3x3().normalized() if base_rot is None else base_rot
        self.B = mw; self.Bi = mw.inverted()
        bones = arm.data.bones
        self.rest = {b.name: b.matrix_local.to_3x3().normalized() for b in bones}
        self.parent = {b.name: (b.parent.name if b.parent else None) for b in bones}
        # hierarchy order
        order = []
        def rec(b):
            order.append(b.name)
            for c in b.children: rec(c)
        for b in bones:
            if b.parent is None: rec(b)
        self.order = order
        # deform-only mapping when DEF bones exist (rigify); else all
        has_def = any(n.lower().startswith("def-") for n in order)
        self.map = {}
        spines = []
        for n in order:
            if has_def and not n.lower().startswith("def-"): continue
            if not has_def and not bones[n].use_deform: continue
            r = role(n)
            if r is None: continue
            if r == "spine":
                spines.append(n); continue
            if r not in self.map: self.map[r] = n
        self.spines = spines[:4]
        # remove constraints and drivers so FK posing works
        for pb in arm.pose.bones:
            for c in list(pb.constraints): pb.constraints.remove(c)
            pb.rotation_mode = "QUATERNION"
        if arm.animation_data:
            arm.animation_data.action = None
            for d in list(arm.animation_data.drivers):
                try: arm.animation_data.drivers.remove(d)
                except Exception: pass
        self.keyed = [n for n in [self.map.get(k) for k in self.map] if n] + self.spines

    def solve(self, pose):
        """pose: dict. limbs 'uaL','faL','hdL','thL','snL','ftL' (+R) -> direction Vector in character space.
        'spine','neck','head','hips' -> (x,y,z) degrees euler in character space."""
        P = {}; L = {}
        inv_map = {v: k for k, v in self.map.items()}
        nsp = max(1, len(self.spines))
        for n in self.order:
            par = self.parent[n]
            R = self.rest[n]
            if par is None: P0 = R.copy()
            else: P0 = P[par] @ (self.rest[par].inverted() @ R)
            key = inv_map.get(n)
            Q = None
            if n in self.spines and "spine" in pose:
                e = pose["spine"]; Q = Euler([math.radians(a) / nsp for a in e]).to_matrix()
            elif key in ("neck", "head", "hips") and key in pose:
                e = pose[key]; Q = Euler([math.radians(a) for a in e]).to_matrix()
            elif key and key in pose:
                d = Vector(pose[key]).normalized()
                da = (self.Bi @ d).normalized()
                y0 = P0.col[1].normalized()
                Q = y0.rotation_difference(da).to_matrix()
            if Q is not None:
                if key in ("neck", "head", "hips") or n in self.spines:
                    Q = self.Bi @ Q @ self.B
                Pn = Q @ P0
                L[n] = (P0.inverted() @ Pn).to_quaternion()
            else:
                Pn = P0
            P[n] = Pn
        return L

    def apply(self, pose, frame=None):
        L = self.solve(pose)
        pbs = self.arm.pose.bones
        for n in self.keyed:
            q = L.get(n, Quaternion())
            pbs[n].rotation_quaternion = q
            if frame is not None: pbs[n].keyframe_insert("rotation_quaternion", frame=frame)

# ---------------- pose library (character space) ----------------
def V(x, y, z): return (x, y, z)
STAND = dict(uaL=V(0.18, 0.02, -1), faL=V(0.1, -0.12, -1), uaR=V(-0.18, 0.02, -1), faR=V(-0.1, -0.12, -1),
             thL=V(0.03, 0, -1), snL=V(0.03, 0.02, -1), thR=V(-0.03, 0, -1), snR=V(-0.03, 0.02, -1),
             spine=(0, 0, 0), neck=(0, 0, 0), head=(0, 0, 0))
def P(base, **kw):
    d = dict(base); d.update(kw); return d
SIT = P(STAND, thL=V(0.08, -1, -0.05), snL=V(0.02, 0.15, -1), thR=V(-0.08, -1, -0.05), snR=V(-0.02, 0.15, -1),
        uaL=V(0.12, -0.35, -1), faL=V(0.0, -1, -0.15), uaR=V(-0.12, -0.35, -1), faR=V(0.0, -1, -0.15))
DRIVE = P(SIT, uaL=V(0.2, -0.6, -0.8), faL=V(-0.25, -1, 0.35), uaR=V(-0.2, -0.6, -0.8), faR=V(0.25, -1, 0.35))
CHEER = P(STAND, uaL=V(0.45, -0.1, 1), faL=V(0.2, 0, 1), uaR=V(-0.45, -0.1, 1), faR=V(-0.2, 0, 1), head=(-12, 0, 0))
SHRUG = P(STAND, uaL=V(0.35, 0.1, -1), faL=V(0.6, -0.8, 0.25), uaR=V(-0.35, 0.1, -1), faR=V(-0.6, -0.8, 0.25), head=(0, 12, 0), neck=(0, 0, 0))
FACEPALM = P(STAND, uaR=V(-0.25, -0.75, -0.4), faR=V(0.45, -0.25, 1), head=(28, 0, 0), spine=(12, 0, 0))
POINT = P(STAND, uaR=V(-0.15, -1, 0.15), faR=V(-0.1, -1, 0.15))
PHONE = P(STAND, uaR=V(-0.1, -0.35, -1), faR=V(0.25, -0.7, 0.75), head=(18, 0, 0))
THUMB = P(STAND, uaR=V(-0.35, -0.6, -0.5), faR=V(-0.1, -0.35, 1))
STARTLE = P(STAND, uaL=V(0.7, 0.1, -0.5), faL=V(0.4, -0.5, 0.8), uaR=V(-0.7, 0.1, -0.5), faR=V(-0.4, -0.5, 0.8), head=(-10, 0, 0), spine=(-8, 0, 0))
SLUMP = P(STAND, spine=(22, 0, 0), head=(25, 0, 0), uaL=V(0.1, -0.2, -1), uaR=V(-0.1, -0.2, -1), faL=V(0.05, -0.3, -1), faR=V(-0.05, -0.3, -1))
LEAN = P(SIT, spine=(18, 0, 0), head=(-10, 0, 0), uaL=V(0.25, -0.8, -0.6), faL=V(0.1, -1, 0.1), uaR=V(-0.25, -0.8, -0.6), faR=V(-0.1, -1, 0.1))

def run_pose(ph, amp=1.0, lean=12):
    s = math.sin(ph); c = math.cos(ph)
    a = 0.85 * amp
    return P(STAND, spine=(lean, 0, 0), head=(-lean * 0.6, 0, 0),
             thL=V(0.05, -a * s * 0.9, -1), snL=V(0.03, 0.2 + max(0, a * c) * 1.2, -1),
             thR=V(-0.05, a * s * 0.9, -1), snR=V(-0.03, 0.2 + max(0, -a * c) * 1.2, -1),
             uaL=V(0.25, a * s * 0.8, -1), faL=V(0.1, -0.9, 0.2 + 0.2 * s), uaR=V(-0.25, -a * s * 0.8, -1), faR=V(-0.1, -0.9, 0.2 - 0.2 * s))

def walk_pose(ph, amp=1.0):
    s = math.sin(ph); c = math.cos(ph)
    a = 0.42 * amp
    return P(STAND, thL=V(0.04, -a * s, -1), snL=V(0.03, 0.05 + max(0, a * c) * 0.9, -1),
             thR=V(-0.04, a * s, -1), snR=V(-0.03, 0.05 + max(0, -a * c) * 0.9, -1),
             uaL=V(0.16, a * s * 0.6, -1), uaR=V(-0.16, -a * s * 0.6, -1))

def blend(a, b, k):
    out = {}
    for key in set(a) | set(b):
        va = a.get(key, b.get(key)); vb = b.get(key, va)
        out[key] = tuple(va[i] + (vb[i] - va[i]) * k for i in range(3))
    return out
